comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: A caster friend reports that Steel, Shot, Muskets, and Arquebuses trade goods are available for sale. I'm not sure if this is unique to World Clock 17th Century, phase two, however; other 17th Century eras -might- have these trade goods available as well. Only time (or digging in Asian databases) will tell.
